rationale: The accepted linkage interpretation identifies scalar residual RMS as mechanistically incomplete. Mean tokenwise cosine(H,R) was prospectively captured as a secondary injection metric and is the smallest available direction-sensitive summary that does not require model loading, raw tensors, GPU use, or regeneration.

mechanism_metric.interpretation: Compressed directional alignment between the current hidden state and local residual, not attribute content and not an attribute-specific vector direction.

prespecified_aggregation: For every trace task and each complete CFG-branch by 3x3 block/denoising cell, take the arithmetic mean of all frozen row-level mean_tokenwise_cosine_h_r values.
Require exact task-cell position counts of 119,119,112 across denoising early,middle,late for each seven-site block group.
Average the four seed task-cell values within each frozen reference unit.
Form positive-minus-control within each frozen matched pair.
Construct eyeglasses outcomes by the already-approved four-seed human-consensus mean and reuse the ten frozen facial-hair outcome values unchanged.
Join separately by attribute and formal_pair_id.
Compute Spearman rank correlation with average ranks for every one of the 36 attribute-by-branch-by-block-by-denoising cells.

directional_interpretation_rules.positive_rho: Within that fixed attribute panel and cell, a larger positive-minus-control cosine contrast co-varies with a larger retention outcome.
directional_interpretation_rules.near_zero_rho: The compressed mean-cosine contrast does not rank retention heterogeneity in that cell; this does not refute the local route or vector/token mechanisms.
directional_interpretation_rules.negative_rho: A larger positive-minus-control cosine contrast co-varies inversely with retention in that cell; this does not imply harmful causal injection.
directional_interpretation_rules.mixed_grid: Consistent with stage/state dependence of this compressed observable; not localization.
directional_interpretation_rules.coherent_grid: Broad descriptive covariation only; not route necessity, sufficiency, or causal alignment.

deferred_existing_summaries.token_rms_quantiles: Deferred to avoid expanding the next family from 36 to 108 coefficients before evaluating the minimal direction-sensitive diagnostic.
deferred_existing_summaries.per_frame_rms: Deferred because 13 latent-frame summaries are repeated measurements and a scientifically justified complete-family reporting design is not yet fixed.
deferred_existing_summaries.raw_vector_or_token_pattern: Unavailable from run-003; raw tensors were prospectively forbidden and not persisted.
